description_en: Authorizes a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance to communicate with a Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance that belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 将云连接网实例授权给跨账号云企业网实例
kebab_example: aliyun smartag grant-instance-to-cbn --cen-uid 1250123456123456 --ccn-instance-id ccn-n2935s1mnwv8i00000 --cen-instance-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jm00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GrantInstanceToCbn

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the CEN instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 云企业网实例所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: cen_uid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CCN instance
parameters.name: ccn_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the CCN instance is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~69813~~l) operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
云连接网实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~69813~~l)接口查询智能接入网关支持的地域以及对应的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to grant the CEN instance permissions to manage network traffic from the CCN instance. Valid values:

true: grants permissions.
false: does not grant permissions. This is the default value.

If you set the value to true and the SAG instance connected to the CCN instance has the secure rerouting feature enabled, you cannot revoke the permissions
parameters.help_zh:
是否给跨账号的云企业网实例授权云连接网实例的流量服务能力。

true：授权。
false：（默认值）不授权。

在您授权成功后，如果云连接网下的智能接入网关实例开启了安全引流功能，则不允许取消授权
parameters.name: grant_traffic_service
